Title: Azure Stream Analytics clusters with VNet support (Preview)

Body.Content:
Azure Stream Analytics clusters is a brand new single-tenant (Dedicated) offering that supports Azure Virtual Network (VNet). This SKU is ideal for customers with medium to large streaming workloads and have strong enterprise security requirements. 

Key features of this preview offering:

  • Single tenant hosting: Your resources are truly isolated and perform better at handling any burst in traffic.
  • Scalability between 36 to 216 SUs: Larger sizes will be offered in the future.
  • VNet support: Allows your Stream Analytics jobs to connect to your resources securely using private endpoints.
  • Zero maintenance cost: Allows you to focus on building real time analytics solutions.
